# Code of conduct

This project follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
It applies in the repository's issues, pull requests and reviews, and anywhere you represent the
project.

## Reporting

To report behaviour that breaks it, send a private report through the repository's **Security** tab
(**Report a vulnerability**) and start the title with "Conduct". GitHub shows it only to the
repository's administrators and security managers.
